body.x: CLASSUM has presented CLASSUM, an interactive learning platform, in CES 2019 ‘Design & Source & MIK NIGHT’, the largest technology show held in Las Vegas, USA from January 8 (Tue) to 11 (Fri).
The service of CLASSUM is a unique UI/UX which breaks the communication barrier between student to student and teacher to a student based on chatting UI and SNS functions.
Through A.I. and big data analyzing technology, it can obtain overall information of the class and improve class by providing direction of improvement and statistics about the class to the educator.

This technology is a UI/UX and function fit for lecture communication which has a simple and direct design anyone can use easily. It suggests a direction for class improvement and shows the current state of the class.

Authority of CLASSUM said “We started from a simple question, ‘how can we effectively enhance learning efficiency.’ We are interactive learning platform. We do our best to make lecture communication easier, simpler, and smarter for better education”. The authority added that “We are aiming to advance into European market or private educational institution for class assisting service, Southeast Asia market which is an emerging market for LMS service."
